# Moonlight Desktop MCP

> A local stdio Model Context Protocol server that lets MCP clients and coding agents see and operate a paired Apollo or Sunshine Windows desktop over Moonlight/GameStream.

This server runs on the controlling macOS, Linux, or Windows machine. It opens
Apollo's Desktop stream, returns screenshots, and sends mouse and keyboard
input in the screenshot coordinate space. It does not provide a Windows shell,
registry access, process inspection, or a Windows-side agent. Install it with
the repository's platform installer rather than npm or npx.

## Start here

- [Project overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edulelis/moonlight-desktop-mcp/main/README.md): Purpose, supported workflow, installation commands, and safety boundaries.
- [Install and update](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edulelis/moonlight-desktop-mcp/main/docs/INSTALL.md): Controller prerequisites, managed installation, MCP client configuration, updates, and private state locations.
- [Use the MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edulelis/moonlight-desktop-mcp/main/docs/USE.md): Pairing and the required capture, input, and visual-verification loop.
- [Tool reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edulelis/moonlight-desktop-mcp/main/docs/TOOLS.md): Complete MCP tool groups and identifiers.
- [Agent operating guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edulelis/moonlight-desktop-mcp/main/docs/AGENT-GUIDE.md): Target selection, authorization, session ownership, and visible-verification rules.

## Architecture and safety

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edulelis/moonlight-desktop-mcp/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Controller/host boundary, transport, coordinates, credentials, and native bridge.
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edulelis/moonlight-desktop-mcp/main/docs/SECURITY.md): Threat boundaries and handling of pairing keys, frames, and input.
- [Compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edulelis/moonlight-desktop-mcp/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): Supported hosts, controllers, codecs, and known limits.
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edulelis/moonlight-desktop-mcp/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): Installation, pairing, stream, capture, OCR, and cleanup failures.
